text:
vivian: noticing higher tail latency on /v1/chat-completions canary-5 after today's roll (2026-03-23 08:05 UTC). p95 ~2.1x baseline, p999 spikes.

deploybot: Alert: canary-5 p95=680ms (baseline 300ms). Autorevert policy p95>750ms for 3m not yet hit. Recommending manual review.

aiden: Any common denom? model variant, kvcache change, or new batching?

vivian: All long traces correlate with requests hitting model=rwkv-9b-quant and payloads with tokens>5k. Logs show kernel flag_lock contention.

clare: If it's model-specific, can we route canary-5 requests for rwkv-9b-quant to fallback model while investigating? Quick command: `deployctl traffic-split --route /v1/chat-completions --slice canary-5 --model rwkv-9b-quant:0.0 -> rwkv-9b:stable:100`

oncall-bot: Incident created incident/2026-03-23-rwkv-tail. Pagerduty oncall Nora notified.

aiden: I'm +1 for model fallback on slice; less blast radius than full rollback. Claire run the traffic-split?

clare: executing now. `deployctl` returns success at 2026-03-23T08:12:10Z.

vivian: Observability: p95 dropped to 330ms across canary-5 within 45s. p999 tails greatly reduced.

deploybot: Noted. Will block autorevert for 20m so we can validate.

aiden: Also opening INFRA-7450 to prevent config-uploader from reintroducing the quant variant until root cause fixed.

oncall-bot: Incident updated: mitigation applied; monitoring window open for 20m. Next update due 08:32 UTC.

nora: Oncall watching; will escalate if p95 >600ms for 5m.

vivian: Drafting customer note: "We rerouted a small canary subset from an experimental quantized model after observing increased tail latency for very long inputs. We've mitigated and are investigating root cause." Will share after 10m observation.

clare: After stable window, plan: revert traffic-split, patch model build to address flag_lock, and re-run canary with stricter p999 autorevert.

aiden: Agreed. Good quick mitigation.
